parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-16, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 312.0 | 6.08 | 6.08
2 | 794.3 | 14.76 | 20.84
3 | 884.4 | 3.48 | 24.32
4 | 1280.2 | 10.95 | 35.27
5 | 4929.0 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

The given layer resistivities in depth order are:
1.  $r_1 = 312.0$ $\Omega\text{m}$
2.  $r_2 = 794.3$ $\Omega\text{m}$
3.  $r_3 = 884.4$ $\Omega\text{m}$
4.  $r_4 = 1280.2$ $\Omega\text{m}$
5.  $r_5 = 4929.0$ $\Omega\text{m}$

According to the rule, for a curve with $N=5$ layers, we identify $N-2 = 3$ groups of three consecutive layers:

1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** $312.0 < 794.3 < 884.4$. This follows the rule $r_1 < r_2 < r_3$, which corresponds to the letter **A**.
2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** $794.3 < 884.4 < 1280.2$. This follows the rule $r_1 < r_2 < r_3$, which corresponds to the letter **A**.
3.  **Layers 3-4-5:** $884.4 < 1280.2 < 4929.0$. This follows the rule $r_1 < r_2 < r_3$, which corresponds to the letter **A**.

The sequence of letters is AAA. According to the rule, "If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A)."

A

{"curve_type": "A"}
